note: Plasmablasts: antibody-secreting B-lineage cells — small cluster at the upper-right (CD38++, CD27++), separated from the sparse background at lower CD27 and CD38.
tips: Plasmablast identification within the CD19+ CD20- pool. Plasmablasts: CD38++ CD27+. Parent design is important: plasmablasts are CD20-low/negative, so they would be missed if gated from the CD20+ (mature B) branch — hence the separate parent at Step 2. The CD19+ CD20- parent also contains CD19+CD20- non-plasmablast residuals, which are excluded by requiring CD27+ CD38++ here.
